cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(hp_os_input_backend LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Network)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(WAYLAND REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET wayland-client)
pkg_check_modules(XKB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET xkbcommon)
pkg_check_modules(RIME REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET rime)
find_program(WAYLAND_SCANNER wayland-scanner REQUIRED)
foreach(protocol input-method-unstable-v2 virtual-keyboard-unstable-v1)
 add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${protocol}-client-protocol.h ${protocol}-protocol.c
  COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER} client-header ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/protocols/${protocol}.xml ${protocol}-client-protocol.h
  COMMAND ${WAYLAND_SCANNER} private-code ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/protocols/${protocol}.xml ${protocol}-protocol.c
  DEPENDS protocols/${protocol}.xml)
 list(APPEND PROTOCOL_SOURCES ${protocol}-protocol.c)
endforeach()
add_executable(hp-os-input-backend main.cpp ${PROTOCOL_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(hp-os-input-backend PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hp-os-input-backend PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Network PkgConfig::WAYLAND PkgConfig::XKB PkgConfig::RIME)
target_compile_options(hp-os-input-backend PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
install(TARGETS hp-os-input-backend RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
enable_testing()
add_executable(test-input-state test_state.cpp)
add_test(NAME input-state COMMAND test-input-state)
add_executable(test-rime test_rime.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test-rime PRIVATE PkgConfig::RIME)
add_test(NAME rime-pinyin COMMAND test-rime)
# Assertions are test gates even for release builds.
target_compile_options(test-input-state PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
target_compile_options(test-rime PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
# Opt-in fixture for isolated compositor acceptance; never started as a service.
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets)
add_executable(hp-os-input-test-client test_client.cpp)
target_link_libraries(hp-os-input-test-client PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Network)
install(TARGETS hp-os-input-test-client RUNTIME DESTINATION libexec)
